description.value: The study investigated voxel-based morphometry correlates of neuropsychiatric symptoms in presymptomatic and symptomatic carriers of GRN, C9orf72, and MAPT mutations in the GENFI cohort.

spans.text: In this study, we applied voxel-based morphometry (VBM) to a large international cohort of presymptomatic and symptomatic carriers of FTD-related mutations.

value: We hypothesized that neuroanatomical correlates of NPS would be distinct between the different forms of genetic FTD and would bring evidence of overlapping brain structural changes with primary psychiatric disorders.

spans.text: T1-weighted images were normalized and segmented into grey matter, white matter (WM), and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) probability maps, by using standard procedures and the fast-diffeomorphic image registration algorithm (DARTEL) [ 16 ].
